honest_limit: V2-V4 hostile variants were not re-measured in this lane, and no native-path coverage exists. Reporting a native success would be exactly the no-coverage green the commission forbids.

named_blocker.statement: A non-subclassable C owner with one-shot sealed custody is buildable here, but a faithful port of the P07 adjudicator (12 decision states, the CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY precedence ladder, exact-key relation key derivation, authority positivity adjudication, custody hash and replay identity) must either reimplement canonical-JSON and semantic_hash in C with byte-exact parity, or call trusted Python canonicalize/semantic_hash from native code at decision time. Neither route was completed and verified here.
what_a_full_completion_requires: non-subclassable heap type with one-shot C-memory custody sealed at construction
deep copy + validation of all relation and authority-snapshot material into C-owned canonical bytes
native by_ref/by_key maps with exact-key-only lookup
faithful native port of _decide_from_owner_state, _validate_positive_from_owner_state, _owner_state_resolve_exact and the replay-identity chain
documented trusted-Python TCB calls (canonicalize/semantic_hash/require_positive_authority) OR byte-exact C reimplementation
adaptation of 3577 lines of introspection-coupled P07/F7 tests that reach __closure__, cell.cell_contents and resolver method monkeypatching, preserving adversarial intent without deleting hard tests
byte-exact parity proof against the accepted Python owner on all 12 states and all five productive paths
the four hostile variants re-run on the ACTUAL native path
a non-shippable native owner binding fail-capability with a separate build manifest proving test mode cannot ship
named_blocker.why_not_ship_a_partial_native_module: A custody-only native capsule is explicitly forbidden, and retaining the Python owner as the positive decider would violate 'no duplicate Python owner capable of positive decisions'. A partial artifact would therefore be architecturally non-compliant rather than merely incomplete.

not_claimed: any forgery fails on an actual native path
any downstream F7 terminal positive sink
one_line: The commission's explicit environment gate is answered definitively in the affirmative: a governed CPython 3.11.3 native extension CAN be compiled and imported on this Mac, so an environment blocker would be dishonest. The actual blocker is scope/parity: the mandate requires the FULL P07 adjudicator ported natively with byte-exact semantic parity, and every partial shape the commission permits me to ship is either forbidden (storage-only capsule, duplicate Python positive owner) or unverifiable. I shipped no native module.
recommendation: Re-dispatch the native owner implementation with the adjudication-parity work broken into explicit sequenced sub-lanes: (a) native custody + exact resolve, (b) native decision port with parity harness, (c) test adaptation, (d) hostile re-run and fail-capability. The environment is proven capable and is not the obstacle.
